title: Get All Apps Working End to End
description: Fix all broken apps and get the full monorepo working end to end: fix workspace dependency issues, build all apps, run all tests.
summary:
Fixed standalone apps collapsing/growing vertically and hanging.

## Root cause
Standalone os-dev globals.css declared no Tailwind v4 @source globs, so the compiled stylesheet shipped ~96 class rules without flex-1/min-h-0/overflow-hidden. Nested h-full then resolved against content-sized parents and heights compounded (prior probe: node-graph host 196374px tall). Demonstrator looked fine because it declared @source for the UI react target (still incomplete for co-located elements).

Also fixed Render error: contextMenuContentClassName is not defined — ContextMenuChrome in the UI react index called a private helper that was never imported; inlined the classname and removed the unused helper.

## Fix
- UI react globals.css: @source . + @source for UI elements.
- New OS renderer react globals.css: imports UI globals; sources engine elements + infinite canvas/world.
- os-dev / demonstrator / storybook entries import the renderer stylesheet; keep only own + plugin renderer @sources; drop stale infinite globs.
- Animate present globals gains @source .
- Pure UI consumers drop redundant UI react @source; fixed stale compose desktop + praesentation relative paths.
- Widened checkStorybookFreshness in script.ts to validate all app Tailwind entries @import/@source paths and UI import chain.

## Verified
- Compiled CSS on procedural:3d contains flex-1, min-h-0, overflow-hidden (~285KB vs prior 174KB / 96 selectors).
- Layout probes (1440x900): procedural3d, gis2d, fem2d, demonstrator — layout 1440x900, host ~807px, body scrollH===clientH, no contextMenuContentClassName render error.
- @semio-tech/ui-react tests matching ContextMenu|Pane defaults|Layout: 37 passed.

## Follow-up (empty procedural windows after some time)
Published built extension crates into `🔌️extension-modules` and ordered publish-before-hot-swap SSE so `/extensions/*` resolves under load/hot-reload. Probe after settle: no extension 404s/worker crashes, windows stay mounted without ShellFaultBoundary.
